title: Network Engineer
summary: A network engineer keeps a company's office, data centre and cloud networks connected and secure. They sit in the IT infrastructure team and handle routers, switches, firewalls and VPNs, often working tickets through ITIL processes (a standard way IT teams handle incidents and changes).
dailyDuties: Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, VLANs, OSPF and BGP
Manage firewall rules and site-to-site VPNs
Watch links and devices in monitoring tools and act on alerts
Work tickets and changes through ITIL processes
Find root causes of outages and slow links
Connect offices and data centres to cloud VPCs or VNets
Update network diagrams and handover notes

skills.expectation: Know TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and load balancing well enough to troubleshoot
Configure and troubleshoot routers and switches, VLANs, OSPF and BGP
Manage firewall rules and site-to-site VPNs
Watch links and devices with monitoring tools and act on alerts
Work tickets and changes through ITIL processes
Find root causes of outages and slow links
Keep network diagrams and handover notes current and update users during incidents
Connect offices and data centres to cloud VPCs or VNets
Use the Linux command line for diagnostics
Automate device checks and changes with scripts

certifications.why: The baseline certificate most network engineer listings ask for
Mid-level Indian network engineer postings often ask for CCNP after CCNA.
Network operations in service firms follow ITIL processes.
